summary.text: Melissa Strange is the Democratic nominee for Kentucky's 4th Congressional District and is a first-time candidate. A Northern Kentucky native, she has worked as a supply chain director in the agribusiness industry. She campaigns on restoring trust in government, affordability, and protecting individual medical decision-making, including abortion access.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised in Villa Hills, Kentucky, and now lives in Erlanger, according to her campaign website as reported by WCPO.
A graduate of Dixie Heights High School, Northern Kentucky University and Thomas More University, according to LINK nky.

Has worked for nearly 30 years as a supply chain director for a global nutrition and agribusiness company; LINK nky reports she is a director of supply chain management at Archer Daniels Midland in Erlanger.
Won the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary with 72.4% of the vote, defeating Jesse Brewer, to become the nominee for the open seat.
LINK nky reports she lives in Erlanger with her husband and has two sons.
